summary: StablecoinX Inc. filed an 8-K reporting a September 14, 2026 Waiver Letter with Ethena OpCo and the Ethena Foundation. Effective October 5, 2026, the Ethena Parties permanently waive all lock-up, vesting and unlocking restrictions on Subject ENA Tokens, including a 48-month contractual lock-up tied to tokens purchased in the PIPE connected to the TLGY Acquisition Corporation business combination. The waiver aligns with the Foundation's announced release date for other ENA holders, and creates a five-business-day Funding Sale notice framework. Watch ENA overhang, sale consent rights, and disposition pace.
